pageDescription: Open and recent incidents for your applications, updated live.

empty.title: No incidents match these filters
empty.description: Clear a filter or widen the search to see more incidents.
empty.noIncidentsDescription: Incidents from ServiceNow appear here as soon as Keigan detects them. You can also start an investigation yourself.

newInvestigation.title: Start an investigation
newInvestigation.description: Keigan collects evidence from the selected services and proposes a root cause. Nothing is changed in your systems.
newInvestigation.servicesHelp: Leave all unchecked and Keigan chooses the services from your description and the application topology.
newInvestigation.descriptionHelp: Describe the symptoms, who is affected and when it started. Do not paste personal data; Keigan masks it before analysis.
newInvestigation.startedDescription: Keigan is gathering evidence. This usually takes a minute or two.
